exclusions: Entire known NY review weeks (including direction markers and adjacent chart examples). Boundary exits occur at first excluded NY Monday open. The unfinished Nov 2 week is outside evaluation. Indicators use past known bars across excluded weeks.
setup: Latest completed 12H (UTC 00/12) EMA20>EMA50 at signal start; own NY Monday complete. After NY Tuesday 00:00 a 5m low pierces the lower 1.618 and closes above it before the bullish signal K. Keep looking for entries until week end. All weekdays; 12H close reclaim is not a requirement.
entry: New closed 5m EMA20/50 upward cross. Fees charged on next actual 5m open. Same crossing and execution for each arm. Primary comparison screens all entries; secondary comparison takes the first eligible entry in each NY week in all arms and screens only subsequent attempts.
bottom: Previous positive EMA leg peak then min low strictly after that peak and before down flip (L1); min low from down flip to pre-signal close (L2). Strictly intervening complete bars supply rebound. Absolute low difference <= 0.25 pre-signal Wilder ATR14 and intervening high >= larger low + 1 ATR.
trend: Previous positive cloud leg had a close above Monday low; (L2 - Monday low)/pre-signal ATR14 between 0 and 1 inclusive; >=1 consecutive closed 1H close above both own EMA20/50. Target-space ratio is descriptive, not used to filter a cloud-exit strategy.
stop: Confirmed upcross lower cloud edge minus 0.1 * signal-close 5m Wilder ATR14; rounded down to 0.1 USDT; fixed. Owner confirmed on Nov 6.
exit: Market stop or next bar open following first confirmed 5m downcross. Excluded/end evaluation week boundary liquidates surviving positions. One leg, no take-profit.
execution_limits: No added spread/slippage, funding, latency or impact; OHLC open gaps preserved. Quote PnL normalized to constant entry notional, no compounding. R based on actual open minus initial protective stop, before fees. Net R numerator deducts both fees.
major_wave: Peak gross favorable movement from entry until scheduled exit OPEN (even if stopped before), divided by initial price risk. Separately report baseline net >=5R and >=10R captured at actual exit, and 2-percent absolute price waves. Each baseline flip cycle counts once.
matched_control: Random subset without replacement of new bullish cloud flips, same BTC / NY week / pre-signal (ATR14 / close) bucket. Baseline compared against all bullish-bias complete-Monday flips in that week, including pre-reclaim; admission filters against all baseline flips. Conditioning on flips tests incremental admission, not flip edge against arbitrary times.
large_definition_secondary: Net base trades >=10R and >0 are shown as sensitivity metrics; threshold selection is not optimized.
trend_original_wording_sensitivity: Fixed after candidate counts (strict=0) and before any real-sample PnL was available: the prior review's literal support-hold definition was D>=0 with no upper proximity limit, previous bull-leg close above Monday low, 1H streak>=1. Report alongside—not replacing—the strict pre-registered <=1 ATR arm. No search or extra native replay.
